title: What's New: Key Updates in Learning Content (docs) for Systems Architects and Integration Developers

chapters.title: New Integration Landing Page and Navigation
Microsoft 365, Office Apps, and Power Platform Integrations
Dynamics Products, Dataverse, and Azure Services Integrations
Microsoft Entra, Infrastructure Services, and Web Services
Key Takeaways and Documentation Best Practices

features.name: Integration Overview Documentation
features.description: New comprehensive guidance and documentation for understanding how integrations work between Business Central and various services and products, including foundational services, Microsoft 365 apps, Power Platform, Dynamics products, and Azure services.

features.name: New Integration Landing Page (aka.ms/bc-integration)
features.description: A new dedicated landing page providing an overview of all integration topics with navigation to detailed documentation for each integration class including Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Dynamics products, Azure services, and web services.

features.name: Microsoft 365 and Office Apps Integration Documentation
features.description: Documentation covering integrations with Excel, Word, Outlook and other Microsoft 365 and Office applications, including diagrams showing data flow to and from Business Central.

features.name: Power Platform Integration Documentation
features.description: Documentation covering Power Platform integrations primarily using REST APIs with the Power Platform connector, including detailed guidance for Power Platform products integration.

features.name: Dynamics Products and Dataverse Integration Documentation
features.description: Documentation covering integration methods with Dynamics products and Dataverse including connectors, data synchronization, virtualization, change events, and new business events.

features.name: Azure Services Integration Support
features.description: Documentation covering various Azure services integrations including Application Insights telemetry, Blob Services, File Services, Azure Functions, with support through HTTP client data type in AL and system modules encapsulating Azure APIs.

features.name: Microsoft Entra and Infrastructure Services Documentation
features.description: Documentation covering Microsoft Entra for authentication and authorization, Universal Print, and upcoming Microsoft Purview for audit functionality.

features.name: Network Access Restriction with Security Service Tags
features.description: Capability to restrict network access to and from Business Central using security service tags as part of Microsoft Entra and infrastructure services.

features.name: Web Services Documentation Update
features.description: Updated documentation covering three ways to integrate with web services including REST APIs as the recommended method, OData and SOAP as legacy methods, with coverage of security, troubleshooting, performance and errors.
